name: personal-ai
title: Personal AI
description: Ask Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Ollama, or Apple Intelligence through the local CLIs you already signed in to, and open prompts in the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps.
author: csa819

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask
commands.subtitle: Personal AI
commands.description: Type a prompt and read the reply in Raycast. Pick the provider, model, and thinking level for this run.

commands.name: ask-claude
commands.title: Ask Claude
commands.subtitle: Anthropic
commands.description: Ask Claude through the claude command and read the reply in Raycast.

commands.name: ask-chatgpt
commands.title: Ask ChatGPT
commands.subtitle: OpenAI
commands.description: Ask ChatGPT through the Codex CLI and read the reply in Raycast.

commands.name: ask-grok
commands.title: Ask Grok
commands.subtitle: xAI
commands.description: Ask Grok through the grok command and read the reply in Raycast.

commands.name: ask-ollama
commands.title: Ask Ollama
commands.subtitle: Local
commands.description: Ask a local model through the ollama command and read the reply in Raycast.

commands.name: ask-apple-intelligence
commands.title: Ask Apple Intelligence
commands.subtitle: Shortcuts
commands.description: Send a prompt to a Shortcuts shortcut that calls Apple Intelligence, then show the reply in Raycast.

commands.name: open-claude
commands.title: Open in Claude
commands.subtitle: Desktop app
commands.description: Open the Claude desktop app with your prompt filled in.

commands.name: open-chatgpt
commands.title: Open in ChatGPT
commands.subtitle: Desktop app
commands.description: Open the ChatGPT desktop app with your prompt filled in.

commands.name: manage-prompts
commands.title: Manage Saved Prompts
commands.subtitle: Personal AI
commands.description: Create, edit, and delete prompt templates stored on this Mac.

preferences.name: defaultProvider
preferences.title: Default Provider
preferences.description: Provider used by the Ask command until you pick another one in the window.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: Model id to select when that provider's account list includes it. Leave blank to use the CLI's default, or the first model it returns.
preferences.placeholder: model id from the account list

preferences.name: defaultThinking
preferences.title: Default Thinking
preferences.description: Level id, such as medium or xhigh. Used only when the selected model offers that level. Otherwise the model's own default is selected.

preferences.name: ollamaHost
preferences.title: Ollama Host
preferences.description: Optional OLLAMA_HOST passed to the ollama command. Leave blank to use the CLI default.

preferences.name: appleShortcutName
preferences.title: Apple Intelligence Shortcut
preferences.description: Name of the Shortcuts shortcut that receives your prompt and returns text. Apple Intelligence has no third-party HTTP API.

preferences.name: claudeCliPath
preferences.title: Claude CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional full path to the claude binary. Leave blank to check ~/.local/bin, Homebrew, and /usr/local/bin.

preferences.name: codexCliPath
preferences.title: Codex CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional full path to the codex binary, the official local ChatGPT CLI. Leave blank to check common install locations.

preferences.name: grokCliPath
preferences.title: Grok CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional full path to the grok binary. Leave blank to check ~/.local/bin, ~/.grok/bin, Homebrew, and /usr/local/bin.

preferences.name: ollamaCliPath
preferences.title: Ollama CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional full path to the ollama binary. Leave blank to check Homebrew, /usr/local/bin, and the Ollama app bundle.

preferences.name: shortcutsCliPath
preferences.title: Shortcuts CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional full path to the shortcuts binary. Leave blank to use /usr/bin/shortcuts.
